reuse.why: Uses the existing small helpers (assertBankAccountNotLinked, findOrCreateBank, syncAccount, handleSyncResponse) but no shared link/download routine exists and none is extracted; the provider flow is re-created by copying Akahu.

duplication.why: linkFintegraAccount is a near line-for-line copy of linkAkahuAccount and downloadFintegraTransactions an exact copy of downloadAkahuTransactions with names swapped.

placement.why: Link handler in accounts/app.ts, download in sync.ts, server URL in server-config, type in types/models, matching where the tree puts each provider's pieces.

scope.why: Focused on the provider; the two desktop-client one-liners are needed to satisfy the Record<BankSyncProviders> types after extending SYNC_PROVIDERS.

maintainability.why: A sixth copy of the link flow and a second identical download function widen the per-provider copy pattern, so future fixes must be applied in more places.

bypasses_abstraction.where: No shared link/download abstraction exists in the tree; the change uses the existing helpers it could.

disguised_duplication.where: The copies of linkAkahuAccount (app.ts) and downloadAkahuTransactions (sync.ts) are open, only renamed per provider, not reshaped.
